step.second_review.help: A second, senior reviewer checks after the first one.
step.second_review.label: Second review
step.senate.help: AI judges vote on segments inside the uncertainty band.
step.senate.label: Review senate
step.tm.help: Reuse context and exact matches from your translation memory.
step.tm.label: TM pre-translation
step.translation_senate.help: Several engines translate; the senate picks the best candidate.
step.translation_senate.label: Translation senate
tier.ai_review.blurb: Every segment below threshold is revised and voted on by the AI senate.
tier.ai_review.label: AI review
tier.auto.blurb: Machine translation with QE gating. Uncertain segments go to the AI senate.
tier.auto.label: Auto
tier.full.blurb: Every segment is reviewed by a qualified human, with AI checks as a second pair of eyes.
tier.full.label: Full human
tier.hybrid.blurb: Confident segments ship automatically; the rest go to a vetted human reviewer.
tier.hybrid.label: Hybrid
workflow.problem.aiReviewNoHuman: Tier AI review cannot contain human review or second review.
workflow.problem.autoNoReview: Tier Auto cannot contain human review, second review or AI review.
workflow.problem.deliveryLast: Delivery must be the last step.
workflow.problem.duplicate: Each step may appear once: {steps} repeated.
workflow.problem.fullNeedsHuman: Tier Full needs a human review step.
workflow.problem.needsTranslation: A workflow must contain MT or TM.
workflow.problem.qeBeforeReview: QE must come before any review step.
workflow.problem.qeThreshold: QE threshold must be between 0 and 100.
workflow.problem.regulatedTier: Regulated organisations cannot use the Auto or AI review tier.
workflow.problem.reviewBeforeQe: QE must come before any review step ({steps} is before QE).
workflow.problem.secondNeedsFirst: Second review needs a human review step before it.
workflow.problem.tmOnlyNeedsHuman: A TM-only workflow needs human review (unmatched segments are translated by a person).
